description: List schools, nurseries and childcare near an England postcode (full postcode or district such as SE22), nearest first, by straight-line distance from the postcode centre. Each school shows its latest Ofsted outcome, whether it is selective (grammar) and its religious character from the official register, and whether a last distance offered has been published; the figure itself is shown to signed-in Catchmently pass holders.

faith.description: Schools with a religious character: "only" or "exclude", per the official register.

phase.description: Only this kind of school. "other" is special, independent and other schools.

postcode.description: Full postcode (e.g. SE22 8DL) or postcode district (e.g. SE22).

published_distance_only.description: Only schools with a published last distance offered.

radius_miles.description: Straight-line radius in miles, at most 3.

selective.description: Selective (grammar) schools: "only" or "exclude", per the official register.

name: search_near_postcode
title: Schools near a postcode
